title: Hancock–Dibble debate and the shipwreck data

tellings.quote: you can see Graham Hancock debate flint dible and then you can fact checked Flint Dibble and realized that he got all his shipwreck data completely wrong

plain: In a 2024 debate, the writer Graham Hancock, who argues that an advanced civilisation was lost at the end of the ice age, faced the archaeologist Flint Dibble. Michels says that anyone who fact-checks Dibble afterwards will find he got "all his shipwreck data completely wrong". Michels says this himself, without saying what the data was or who did the checking, and uses it to suggest that Hancock's critics are less solid than they seem.
